newsitem.title: USA: Union Pacific Corp Q4 net rises.
newsitem.headline: Union Pacific Corp Q4 net rises.

text.p: (All data above 000s except per share numbers)
NOTE - 1995 Q4 figures are pro forma and reflect results as if Southern Pacific Rail Corp operations had been included and Union Pacific Resources Group operations excluded.
Union Pacific's acquisition of Southern Pacific, and its spin-off of Union Pacific Resources, became effective in September 1996.
1996 Q4 was the first full reporting period to reflect the impact of these two transactions.
Actual reported 1995 Q4 net was $294 million, or $1.43 a share, and oper revs were $1.974 billion. Net included income from discontinued oeprations of $115 million, or $0.56 a share.
(All data above 000s except per share numbers)
1995 year data are actual reported figures, not pro forma.
1996 year net includes income from discontinued operations of $171 million, or $0.78 a share, vs $327 million, or $1.59 a share.
Q4 avg shrs 246.4 million vs pro forma 244.2 million, and for year 218.1 million vs actual 205.8 million.
